mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days across all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strengthening supply chain activity, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls exceeding 200 (thousand) signal robust labor market growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days via elevated consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate systemic demand destruction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contraction regimes, industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals severe supply chain disruption, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through inflationary pressure and reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 during supply contraction, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
